description:
Create a clinical symptom profile visualization for the E. coli outbreak investigation.

Open the Visual Dashboard module in Epi Info 7 and connect to the 'EColi' sample project (FoodHistory form). You must restrict the analysis to confirmed cases only by applying a Data Filter where 'Ill' equals 'Yes'.

Add a 'Combined Frequency' gadget to analyze the following symptoms simultaneously: Diarrhea, BloodyDiarrhea, Fever, Vomiting, Nausea, and AbdominalPain. Configure the gadget to sort categories from High to Low frequency and set the title to 'Symptom Profile of Cases'.

Save the dashboard canvas as 'SymptomProfile.cvs7' in the default Dashboards folder ('C:\Users\Docker\Documents\Epi_Info\Dashboards\').
